</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-04-01to2026-03-31" escape="true" id="Fact002737" name="us-gaap:SubsequentEventsTextBlock"><p id="xdx_80B_eus-gaap--SubsequentEventsTextBlock_zqHtOKQ2YDrb" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><b>Note 22 - <span id="xdx_82A_zXm9IbyFA0N6">Subsequent Events</span></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&#160;</p>


<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%">
  <tr style="vertical-align: top">
    <td style="width: 0.25in"><b>&#160;</b></td>
    <td style="width: 0.25in; text-align: left"><b>1.</b></td>
    <td style="text-align: justify"><b>Nasdaq hearing</b></td> </tr>
  </table>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">On March 31, 2026, the Company received formal notice from the Listing Qualifications Staff (the &#8220;Staff&#8221;) of The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC (&#8220;Nasdaq&#8221;) indicating that the Company&#8217;s non-compliance with the Bid Price Rule would result in the delisting of the Company&#8217;s securities from Nasdaq unless the Company timely requests a hearing before the Nasdaq Hearings Panel (the &#8220;Panel&#8221;). The Company did file a timely request for a hearing before the Panel, which request stayed any further action by Nasdaq pending the issuance of a decision by the Panel and the expiration of any extension the Panel may grant to the Company following the hearing. The Company had its hearing before the Panel on May 7, 2026 and is currently awaiting a decision from the Panel.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">Subsequent to March 31, 2026, pursuant to the Company&#8217;s share repurchase program and in connection with the adoption of a Rule 10b5-1 issuer share repurchase trading plan, the Company repurchased <span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--SharesRepurchsedShares_pid_c20250401__20260331_z6Xvt31LJYge" title="Shares repurchsed, shares"><ix:nonFraction name="aert:SharesRepurchsedShares" contextRef="From2025-04-01to2026-03-31" id="Fact002739" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">2,582,365</ix:nonFraction></span> Class A ordinary shares, increasing the total number of shares repurchased to <span id="xdx_90E_ecustom--SharesRepurchsedShares_pid_c20260401__20260605_zm5Qbh84pi68" title="Shares repurchsed, shares"><ix:nonFraction name="aert:SharesRepurchsedShares" contextRef="From2026-04-012026-06-05" id="Fact002741" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">4,294,927</ix:nonFraction></span> treasury shares held at cost. </p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">Of the total shares repurchased, <span id="xdx_909_ecustom--SharesRepurchsedCancelled_pid_c20260401__20260605__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zXEyjbVhPDk7" title="Shares repurchsed cancelled"><ix:nonFraction name="aert:SharesRepurchsedCancelled" contextRef="From2026-04-012026-06-05_us-gaap_SubsequentEventMember" id="Fact002743" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">2,898,643</ix:nonFraction></span> Class A ordinary shares were subsequently cancelled. The remaining shares are held as treasury shares at cost.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">The Company received a notice, dated April&#160;24, 2026, of non-renewal and buyout from one of its significant customers effective June&#160;30, 2026. This notice also serves as a buyout notice, with a buyout price determined according to the terms and conditions of the contract.</p>

The buy-out resulted in one-time revenue of approximately $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--PreferredStockSharesAuthorized_iI_pid_c20260605__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_z8p1Qwoaecoi" title="Buy-out revenue"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PreferredStockSharesAuthorized" contextRef="AsOf2026-06-05_us-gaap_SubsequentEventMember" id="Fact002747" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">2,700</ix:nonFraction></span>.</p>
